findings.title: Working-hours check is broken: `end` equals `start`, and the condition is inverted
findings.body: In `checkIfIsAvailable`, `end` is computed with the same expression as `start`, so `end` is just the slot start and the slot's end time is never checked. The `find` returns true when the slot lies outside working hours, which then returns false. That is correct only if every working-hours entry is the user's own. Entries can be per-user or day-specific. Also, `workingHour.startTime` and `endTime` are in the organizer's timezone minutes or UTC minutes, while `slotStartTime` is converted to UTC. Because the days and times are not consistently matched, slots can be wrongly rejected or accepted. Note that `...schedule` spreads `workingHours` into this check for every user.

findings.title: Dead comparison of Dayjs objects with ===
findings.body: `dayjs(a) === dayjs(b)` compares object references and is always false, so the zero-length override case (a day fully blocked) is never handled. A date override meaning 'unavailable' (start equals end) falls through to the other checks.

findings.title: Override day matching is done on a shifted UTC date
findings.body: The override start is shifted by the negative of the organizer's UTC offset, which is wrong for matching the slot's UTC day. `dayjs.tz(date.start, tz).utcOffset() * -1` is applied to the start but the slot time is in UTC. This subtracts rather than adds the offset. Also, the override's day comparison against `slotStartTime.format` in UTC is wrong for overrides crossing midnight. Slots can be wrongly allowed or rejected for fixed hosts in non-UTC timezones.

findings.title: Override offset logic ignores missing timeZone and day wrap
findings.body: `dayjs(...).tz(override.timeZone)` is called with an optional `timeZone` that may be undefined. The start and end are shifted by the offset difference and then reduced to hour/minute, so shifts across midnight wrap and produce an end time before the start. Such an override is silently dropped by the `start >= end` guard in buildSlots.
